An '''Ewok''' flew a [[Hang-glider/Legends|hang glider]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Although the Ewok succeeded in dropping rocks upon an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]], the attack had no discernible effect against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[walker]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The website for 2015's [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] identified this Ewok as being played by actor and stuntman [[Felix Silla]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Celebration Anaheim (2015) Autograph Hall">{{Celebration|url=Guests/Autograph-Hall|text=Celebration Autograph Hall: Presented by Official Pix|celebration=[[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]]|nolive=1}}</ref> This casting was once again confirmed in April of 2021, via a [[Lucasfilm]] Instagram post, which paid tribute to Silla, after the actor's passing earlier that week.<ref name="instagram">{{Instagram|username=lucasfilm|url=p/COBB6kRtrGi|name=[[Lucasfilm]]|archivefile=File:FelixSillaPost.jpg}}</ref>

In 2007, Silla had been previously identified as playing a [[Unidentified Ewok (hang glider) 1|darker-furred Ewok]] in the same scene, whose glider is shot down by a stormtrooper's errant blaster fire.<ref name="CIVOPAGL">{{WebCite|url=http://officialpix.com/OPX/Celebrities.html|text=Celebration IV Official Pix Autograph Guest List|archivedate=20071015144459}}</ref> On his personal website, Silla had stated that the hang-gliding Ewok he played was to be called "Retah."<ref name="SillaRotj">{{WebCite|url=http://www.felixsilla.com/rotj.htm|text=Return of the Jedi|author=Felix Silla|work=The Worlds of Felix Silla|archivedate=20160313122842}}</ref> However, neither of the two Ewoks using hang gliders has been officially identified by the name Retah in any [[canon]] source. The [http://www.felixsilla.com current version of Silla's website] now erroneously identifies the hang-gliding Ewok he played as [[Wunka]].
